channel.name: MEsc
channel.language: de (titles auto-translated to English in the default listing)
channel.season: uploads cluster Oct-Jan (channel description: 'ab November/Dezember geht's richtig los')

method.taxonomy: keyword rules over all 218 long + 196 Short titles (scratchpad/scripts/classify.py); heuristic, ~5% misfiled
method.cuts: ffmpeg select gt(scene,0.3) on 360p; 'cut_events' merge detections closer than 1 s to suppress firework flashes/animated graphics; jump cuts in identical framing are under-counted
method.loudness: ffmpeg ebur128 on the 360p AAC stream
method.colours: deterministic k-means (numpy, seed 0) on crops of native 640x360 / 360x640 frames, optional HSV filter

brochure_catalog_review.subject: Retailer New-Year's-Eve fireworks brochures/leaks walked through page by page (Lidl, Aldi Nord/Sued, Netto, Kaufland, Penny, Norma, Edeka, Jawoll, Thomas Philipps ...), with prices, novelties and regional availability.
brochure_catalog_review.structure: hook ('Das Prospekt ist da, meine Freunde') -> exclusivity claim -> page-by-page walkthrough with price commentary -> regional map -> opinion prompt -> catchphrase outro -> fire end screen
shot_types: face-cam picture-in-picture (gaming room, RGB/aurora LED backlight) top-left with thin white border + drop shadow
full-height brochure page scans right, drop shadow
dark fireworks footage as background plate
brochure_catalog_review.pacing: page change roughly every 10 s; 5.9 merged cut events/min (9etWVDZnyOs)
brochure_catalog_review.speech: dense German VO, 172 words/min over duration (densest sample)
brochure_catalog_review.captions: none (only 'WERBUNG' label top-right on sponsored episode)
brochure_catalog_review.titles_graphics: brochure pages are the graphics; regional availability map
brochure_catalog_review.transitions: pixelated mosaic dissolve at start and into end screen
brochure_catalog_review.music: assumption (medium): bed under VO; auto-subs tag [musik] twice
brochure_catalog_review.restraint: high: static layout, no effects during walkthrough
brochure_catalog_review.audience_expectation: complete, fast, accurate price/novelty information on release day
brochure_catalog_review.confidence: medium (1 sampled episode, layout cross-checked against 56 titles + thumbnails)

assortment_product_videos.subject: Full range of one retailer/brand ('ALLE NETTO LESLI BATTERIEN', 'Sortiment + Produktvideos'), where-to-buy guides, relabel detective work.
assortment_product_videos.structure: either (a) uncommented compilation of manufacturer product videos with chapters per item, or (b) VO over product stickers + test clips, ordered by category, catchphrase outro
shot_types: manufacturer/third-party test footage with their own lower thirds and credit watermarks
product cut-out stickers over fireworks or orange plates
brochure scans
full-screen emojis and meme stock clips (2024)
assortment_product_videos.captions: 2023 sample: burned-in word-group captions, condensed ALL CAPS white with black stroke and yellow keyword (#F1E11D); 2024/25 samples: none
assortment_product_videos.transitions: radial zoom blur, light flashes, pixel dissolve to end screen
assortment_product_videos.music: compilation carries manufacturer audio (fireworks) – loudest sample: I -11.0 LUFS, LRA 14.1, true peak +3.8 dBFS
assortment_product_videos.restraint: low in 2024 meme-driven guide; very high in compilation
assortment_product_videos.audience_expectation: see every product effect before buying; know where to get it

ranking_topN.subject: Top 5/10/20 lists, tier rankings, budget shopping lists, 'must-haves for NYE'.
ranking_topN.structure: claim hook (~25 s) -> membership plug -> countdown 'Platz 10' .. 'Platz 1' (~45-55 s each: rank card, product sticker, price, where to buy, test footage) -> recap -> comment prompt -> catchphrase -> ~20 s end screen; YouTube chapters per rank
shot_types: product cut-outs with white outer glow over night fireworks or orange fire plate
own daylight ignition close-ups (gloves, lighter)
night test footage (own + credited third-party)
studio presenter holding product to camera (sponsored 2025)
ranking_topN.speech: VO 146 wpm (favourite), 93 wpm (2021), 75 wpm scripted sponsored
ranking_topN.captions: none; text only on rank/spec/price cards
ranking_topN.titles_graphics: 'PLATZ N' cards (white geometric bold; 2025 with red outline #C4131A), spec cards 'Schuss/Hoehe/Brenndauer/Kosten' white on black, price 'NN,99 EUR' white, retailer logo stickers, black silhouette teasers for upcoming rank, emoji pops
ranking_topN.transitions: radial zoom tunnel, whip/motion blur, white flash + salmon light leak (2025), horizontal carousel slide between ranks (2025), pixel dissolve to end screen
ranking_topN.music: assumption (medium): continuous bed; [Musik]/[Applaus] tags at intro and outro
ranking_topN.restraint: medium: graphics on every rank, but test footage plays uninterrupted
ranking_topN.audience_expectation: clear verdict, price, availability; fun to watch
ranking_topN.confidence: high for structure (3 samples over 4 years + chapters), medium for graphics details

shopping_tour.subject: XXL 600-800 EUR sales-day shopping tour with friends from ~4:30 am through specialist store, Lidl opening rush and discounters; ends with haul spread on the ground.
shopping_tour.structure: letterboxed cold-open teaser 'In diesem Video...' -> meme sketch wake-up -> title card 'Einkaufstour 2025/26' -> chronological stores -> car loading -> haul presentation with close-ups -> catchphrase -> end screen
shot_types: wide-angle action cam handheld/chest POV (barrel distortion uncorrected)
night street/car travel
crowded store interiors
haul close-ups
shopping_tour.speech: spontaneous group talk, 117 wpm; auto-subs tag [gelächter], [musik] (34 tags)
shopping_tour.captions: only teaser text and title card
shopping_tour.titles_graphics: title card: 'Einkaufstour' gold #D5A50A + '2025/26' white, geometric bold, soft glow, centred
shopping_tour.music: assumption (medium): music under travel/montage parts ([musik] tags)
shopping_tour.restraint: low grading effort, high authenticity; no stabilisation/lens correction visible
shopping_tour.audience_expectation: vicarious thrill, crowd chaos, what was bought and for how much

unboxing.subject: Shop/sponsor packages (Pyroland, Pyro Team Store, Lidl, WECO surprise boxes) opened item by item.
unboxing.structure: cold open of the final product pile -> zoom tunnel + membership plug -> opening boxes -> item-by-item -> final pile pan -> sponsor thanks -> catchphrase -> end screen
shot_types: wide-angle desk shot in studio with red neon 'MEsc' sign, wooden slat wall, red LED strip
handheld close-ups of products
unboxing.pacing: 4.1 merged cut events/min (jump cuts inside same framing are under-counted)

nye_vlog_midnight.subject: Midnight fireworks 'ESKALATION' uncut, NYE vlogs.
nye_vlog_midnight.structure: single continuous POV take: fuse-chain prep with aluminium foil under headlamp -> phone clock 23:59 -> ignition -> ~6 min of sky -> end screen
shot_types: head/chest-mounted wide POV
night sky
nye_vlog_midnight.exposure: sky section: mean luma 10.4/255, 86% of pixels <=16, 0.16% clipped
nye_vlog_midnight.music: none evidenced; I -18.1 LUFS, only 0.1% of momentary loudness above -12 LUFS (bangs appear compressed by camera AGC - assumption)

pyro_news_politics.subject: Fireworks-ban news/opinion 2020-2022 (Corona sales bans), reactions.
pyro_news_politics.structure: greeting 'Was geht ab/herzlich willkommen' -> subscribe ask -> disclaimer card -> news VO -> catchphrase -> 'THANKS FOR WATCHING' template outro
shot_types: stock/third-party fireworks footage as background
persistent lower bar: fire strip, wolf badge, 'INSTA: EB.MARVIN'
pyro_news_politics.music: [Musik] at start/end; I -27.4 LUFS (very quiet master)
pyro_news_politics.status: dormant: 72 titles but only 1 in the newest 60 uploads

short_meme.subject: POV/relatable memes about sales day, Lidl rush, buddies ('Markiere deinen Bro').
short_meme.structure: single 7 s shot, caption visible from frame 1, loopable
short_meme.captions: static sentence-case caption in upper third, white geometric bold with dark outline ('POV: ...', 'Bro und ich am 29.12 im Lidl')
short_meme.graphics: animated pile of product cut-outs with yellow 'Nur regional erhaeltlich' stickers (zIxejdVAa0E)
short_meme.notes: footage appears to show people other than the creator (assumption, low-medium: possibly licensed/meme templates)

short_sponsored_lidl.subject: [WERBUNG] Lidl battery tests and 'so much fireworks for 50/100/150 EUR' hauls.
short_sponsored_lidl.structure: test: title card (product + Lidl logo + name + price on teal grid #317087) -> raw night test; haul: split layout face-cam top, product cut-outs on charcoal grid bottom with green prices
short_sponsored_lidl.graphics: price in bright green #01D402 with dark shadow; geometric bold white titles

short_pyroland_product.subject: Pyroland product tests (2025/26 season, all in the newest 60 Shorts).
short_pyroland_product.structure: short product presentation -> raw handheld night test (2:41)

short_versus_poll.subject: 'Was ist besser?' A vs B product polls with community result.
short_versus_poll.structure: 8 s motion graphic: product A -> 'VS' -> product B -> clock (vote moment) -> result split red/blue with percentages
short_versus_poll.graphics: charcoal grid #302F2F, product stickers with white glow, 'VS' white with red stroke, result panels red #B60F00 / blue #055183, white bold percentages, red progress bar at top

short_haul_spend.subject: 'Wir haben fuer 600 EURO Feuerwerk gekauft' haul recaps.
short_haul_spend.structure: 31 s rapid montage of the shopping day with running VO
short_haul_spend.captions: word-group captions ALL CAPS, condensed comic/bold white with black outline, lower-middle

short_stunt_curiosity.subject: 'What happens if ...' stunts, loudest legal firecracker.
short_stunt_curiosity.captions: hook question in condensed ALL CAPS white, keyword highlighted yellow #F4DE19
short_stunt_curiosity.confidence: low-medium (1 sample, possibly re-edited third-party clip)

thumbnail_system.era_2022_2025: blue radial speed-line/warp background, grey-white diagonal corner stripes (same motif as banner), 1-2 words huge comic caps (white, yellow or green) with black outline, big retailer logo, product cut-outs, retailer-style price tags, thick white or red arrows, emoji (heart eyes, mind blown, scream), black mystery box with '?', creator reaction pose
thumbnail_system.era_2020_2021: red/orange fire background, wolf badge bottom-left, white comic caps with red/black outline, politician/meme photos
